module: Node "StartScreen Begin" (color ui). Starts building the start screen of a mission: on the first frame with flow active, it calls modules.ui:startUIBuilding('startScreen'), adds the header (project name), sets the Start button text and, if simple is true, switches the screen to simple mode. Inputs: flow, reset (pulse), triggerStart (pulse, simulates a click on Start), startButtonText (string, default "ui.scenarios.start.start"), simple (bool). Outputs: flow (true once the Start button is clicked), build (chainFlow, one frame to chain the panels). Ends with a "Screen Finish" node.
notes: The timer fallback code (started/startTime) and the onUILayoutLoaded hook are commented out in the file.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets started/done/built and auto-skip when the project starts.

_executionStopped.desc: Called when the project stops; calls closeDialogue (no real effect).

onClientEndMission.desc: End-of-mission hook on the client side; calls closeDialogue.

closeDialogue.desc: Does nothing in practice: the navigation to "play" is commented out.

onNodeReset.desc: Called when the node is reset (reset pin or graph reset).

workOnce.desc: Variant executed only once by the flowgraph engine (empty body here).

work.desc: Handles reset, builds the screen at the first flow, activates build for one frame, publishes done on the output flow pin, triggers startFromUi if triggerStart is received, and applies auto-skip (startingOptions.autoSkipStartScreen, after 2 s of real time).

startFromUi.desc: Simulates the click on Start: sets done=true, emits the onUIStartButtonClicked hook, navigates to the "play" screen and clears modules.ui.uiLayout.
